summary: Shortlist this provisionally for a big, noisy riverside New Year's Eve: live Thai pop performances and a dramatic fireworks setting beside ICONSIAM. The important date correction is that Amazing Thailand Countdown 2026 ran 27–31 December 2025, welcoming 2026. It does not confirm the programme for 31 December 2026, which would welcome 2027. Current third-party 2027 listings still recycle last year's details.
whyGo: A memorable Chao Phraya waterfront setting for midnight fireworks.
Potential combination of live music, mall dining and a shared New Year celebration; previous programmes ran over several evenings.
bestFor: Travellers happy to devote an entire evening to a crowded celebration
skipIf: You dislike dense crowds, loud bangs or long periods standing
You need a guaranteed seat, easy exit or early bedtime
duration: Planning allowance: 5–8 hours including early arrival and departure; exact 2026 gates and performance times unconfirmed.
cost: 2027-event admission and zone rules unconfirmed. The previous edition mixed limited free walk-in/app access with shopping-linked ticket privileges. Restaurant, hotel and cruise packages are separate purchases; budget food and transport additionally.
hours: 31 December 2026 is a provisional target only. Regular mall hours are 10:00–22:00; these do not establish countdown access hours.
bestTime: Arrive well before midnight once the organiser publishes admission instructions; an early-evening arrival is a planning suggestion, not a guarantee of entry.
gettingThere: ICONSIAM, 299 Charoen Nakhon Road, Khlong San. The venue lists BTS, public boats and shuttle boats as transport options. Prefer public transport over driving; independently confirm any late-night extensions, last boats and event-day restrictions before committing.
booking: Wait for the official 2027 event announcement and zone map. Do not assume walking into the shopping centre grants access to River Park. Reserve any riverside dinner separately and ask whether it guarantees an unobstructed fireworks view.
accessibility: Mall facilities offer an indoor base, but step-free event routes, accessible viewing areas, seating and re-entry arrangements are not established. Confirm these with ICONSIAM before shortlisting for limited mobility.
practicalTips: Keep a departure plan that still works if boats finish before you leave.
Agree a meeting point and carry a charged phone, drinking water and hearing protection if sensitive to noise.
Choose a restaurant or hotel viewing package if a seat matters, after checking its actual sightline and cancellation terms.
decemberNotes: Treat this as a conditional 31 December option in a December 2026 itinerary. Official government coverage verifies the historical 2025 dates only; artists, multi-day concerts and admission promotions from that edition must not be carried forward.
uncertainties: No official 2027 programme, ticket release, lineup or fireworks timing verified.
Capacity, accessible viewing, bag restrictions, re-entry and midnight transport arrangements remain unknown.
